fields.description: Porto Playa is a joint Ellington and RAK Properties beachfront development on Hayat Island in Ras Al Khaimah. Its apartment collection is supplemented by limited townhouses, villas and a larger presidential residence.

overview: Beach access and shared leisure spaces accompany a varied mix of conventional apartments and larger premium homes.
research.locationNote: Hayat Island, Mina Al Arab, Ras Al Khaimah. Waterfront views and beach access should be checked for the selected residence.
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s exact starting reference is AED 1,500,828, rounded to AED 1.5 million. Its sold-out label is a portal status, not confirmation of all resale availability or a current selected-unit offer.
research.paymentNote: The table follows the original guide. Its AED 3,000 registration charge and additional 4% title-registration amount sit outside the 100% purchase-price schedule; confirm current applicable fees.
research.handoverNote: The developer guide and partner page anticipate Q4 2026. This is a forecast, not verified completion or handover.
